claims.claim_text: Says she would enforce what she calls a common-sense policy of local houses for local people, citing the concentration of licensed houses in multiple occupation in Ashington and Blyth.
claims.source_quote: I am standing to deliver results from these ongoing schemes and enforce a common-sense policy of local houses for local people, alongside real investment in our healthcare and public spaces.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the candidate statement; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Says she is standing for real investment in local healthcare, stating that residents cannot get NHS dentist or routine GP appointments.
claims.source_quote: Local residents cannot get an NHS dentist appointment or even a routine appointment with a GP, while our frontline infrastructure is left to deteriorate.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the candidate statement; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Says he is standing so that he can play his part in achieving the district's climate goals for 2030.
claims.source_quote: I am putting myself forward to represent Rodborough on the District Council so that I can play my part in achieving our climate goals for 2030.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the candidate statement; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Says she would oppose developments she describes as inappropriate, such as houses in multiple occupation.
claims.source_quote: Oppose inappropriate developments such as HMOs that damage neighbourhoods
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the candidate statement; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Says she would oppose Wales's Nation of Sanctuary policy.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the candidate statement; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Says he would oppose continued council tax rises by targeting what he calls genuine waste.
claims.source_quote: It means opposing continued council tax hikes, as I have done consistently on the community council, by targeting genuine waste.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the candidate statement; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Says he would fight proposals for what he calls inappropriate development on green spaces.
claims.source_quote: That means fixing the potholes in and around the village, fighting proposals for inappropriate development on green spaces, and improving our bus service, with evening and Sunday services.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the candidate statement; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Says he would sort the drainage problems that leave parts of Higher Kinnerton vulnerable to flooding.
claims.source_quote: It means producing a community speed plan to make our village safer for children and older people, and sorting the drainage issues which leave parts of the village vulnerable to flooding.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the candidate statement; quote checked verbatim)
